body:
Source check finds one agreement and one ownership correction.

Q1: agree that CellCoordinates should surface imputation, but the trace Scaladoc is now stale. CostBreakdown already records imputedTerms after 0ca09c5, along with missingTerms and supportWeight. CellCoordinates.of looks up that exact breakdown and then drops all three. Exposing only imputedTerms would still leave the textual cell trace unable to say how much eligible support was actually measured. The coherent next slice is to carry the looked-up breakdowns audit fields together: measured terms or their values as needed, missingTerms, imputedTerms, supportWeight, and reductions. Do not publish the four-way classifier until eligibility itself is retained; I agree that deriving Ineligible as a complement would be false.

Q2: I do not think document or story should own materialization. build.sbt has document upstream of recall and align, while view already depends on story, document, recall, and align and is explicitly the renderer-neutral derived-artifact seam. Putting the two-sided trace in document would require a new reverse-facing dependency or duplicate alignment vocabulary in a lower module. The materializer belongs in view: accept the validated StoryModel that owns canonical source text, the checked RecallGraph, the HsmmResult, and the source view; verify result recallChecksum and viewFingerprint through CellCoordinates.of, then slice StoryModel.source.canonicalText only after the model/source/atlas invariants hold. That preserves align as coordinate authority and view as text-bearing presentation authority.

I support adding a structural ineligibility reason, but not by overloading MissingReason.Excluded. Excluded currently means policy exclusion of a target/value; not-applicable-to-this-cell is an eligibility fact, and should be retained beside, rather than masquerade as, missing provider evidence.
